summary: # Marvelous Designer Tips - Layering Multiple Clothing Items Together ## Introduction In this video, we will learn how to reverse-activate and shrink the filter to complete a multi-layered clothing dress. This tutorial focuses on techniques to effectively layer clothing items in Marvelous Designer. ## Transferring Materials First, we will transfer the material to the work area. In this case, I will add a little bit of T-shirt fabric to show you later. ## Creating and Modifying Belt Plates We create a belt plate and reverse-activate it. After the plate is reversed, it will not participate in the simulation, and there will be no conflict. ### Adjusting the Tail Shrink Select a set of plates and modify the tail shrink to make the clothes become tight. Combine the belt plates together, then activate them and start the simulation. ## Finalizing the Belt Now the belt is correctly worn on the outside of the clothes. Harden the belt to make it more stable and wrap it around the outside. ### Increasing Tail Shrink Rate Then, increase the tail shrink rate of the chain group to 100. Now that the layer is stable, we will add another coat. ## Adding Additional Layers After the inner layer is worn, we can freeze all the inner layers. This allows them to have a conflict with other layers while maintaining their shape. ### Starting the Simulation Now we add a coat, start the simulation, and adjust the shape of the clothes. ## Conclusion These steps will help you successfully layer multiple clothing items in Marvelous Designer, enhancing your garment design skills. Don't miss out on these essential tips!
